data.name: Sreenivasulu
data.gender_notes: Sreenivasulu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sree (Goddess of Wealth) + Nivas (Dwelling) + Lu (God of Prosperity). The name Sreenivasulu carries the meaning “God of Wealth and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Telugu, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sreenivasulu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence of God in one's life, signifying wealth, prosperity, and protection
data.etymology: Sreenivasulu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wealth and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sreenivasulu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Sreenivasulu" embodies the religious and cultural beliefs of the Hindu community, as it incorporates deities revered for wealth, prosperity, and dwelling, reflecting their deep devotion and connection to their divine patrons.
data.spiritual_significance: This name symbolizes the deep-rooted faith that Hindus hold within their hearts that their gods, Sree (Goddess of Wealth) and Nivas (God of Prosperity), will provide them with blissful dwelling and countless blessings. It instills a sense of endless hope, patient perseverance, and steadfast faith in the power of the Almighty to fulfill their deepest desires. beyond material wealth; Life's ultimate aim is attainment of spiritual growth and inner peace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sreenivasulu: Abode of Sri (Goddess) Narasimha, symbolizing strength, protection, and divine grace.
